description:
Inspect current VFT dashboard evidence and rental admission before selecting bots.

        Call with {} for board IDs, metric definitions and freshness (items is empty),
        then select a board or exact bot_id; both filters intersect. Returns complete
        dashboard rows, ranks, sizing, curves and rental.catalog_admitted. Follow
        next_offset until null. Unknown bots return an empty items list. Stale/unavailable
        evidence is labelled and must not be treated as current eligibility. Use bot_history
        for dated results of the offered cohort, including withdrawn versions. Free,
        unauthenticated read; grants no strategy licence or execution authority.
        Invalid arguments/upstream failure return an MCP tool error.

board.description: Board ID from the overview. Omit with bot_id to search all boards; when both filters are supplied, both must match. Omit both for the overview without rows.

bot_id.description: Exact case-sensitive bot_id from an evaluation row or history record; omit for all bots. Not a symbol, name or partial search.
bot_id.title: Bot Id

limit.description: Maximum rows per page, 1–50; defaults to 20. Applies after board/bot filtering.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Zero-based row offset. Continue with next_offset using the same filters; snapshots may change between pages.
offset.title: Offset

name: evaluate_bots

dashboard.description: Complete original dashboard row, including all nested metrics, sizing, chart points and nulls; interpret using field_guide.
dashboard.title: Dashboard

fresh.description: Whether this row's dashboard section is currently fresh.
fresh.title: Fresh

rank.description: One-based source rank within this board, before bot filtering.
rank.title: Rank

rental.description: Current catalog_admitted flag, admission status and immutable strategy_version when admitted. Board rank alone does not grant access.
rental.title: Rental

boards.description: Board IDs mapped to labels, counts, source sections, freshness status and query URLs.
boards.title: Boards

count.description: Total matching rows across selected boards, before pagination; overview has no rows.
count.title: Count

field_guide.description: Metric definitions, units and limitations for every dashboard field group.
field_guide.title: Field Guide

next_offset.description: Pass as offset with the same filters; null ends this snapshot's page sequence.
next_offset.title: Next Offset

observed_at.description: Snapshot observation time in Unix seconds UTC; null before any snapshot exists.
observed_at.title: Observed At

sections.description: Separate leaderboard/advisory source timestamps, maximum ages, hashes and freshness.
sections.title: Sections
